inspection_kind: Initial construction self-inspection, not a formal review or final approval
inspector: codex / gpt-6.1-sol / xhigh, available speed; no fast-mode claim
method: Viewed actual PNG pixel content with image viewing tools. Inspected six shipped reference PNGs, all individual drone rest/action/gameplay/scale/diagnostic views, the final 21-tile contact sheet and reference sheet, and the exact 1:1 gameplay crop strip. Common-neutral final pixels also inspected in the contact sheet. Script exit status was not treated as visual approval.
findings: Broad clipped shoulders, short unmanned sensor housing and warm oxide/sparse titanium/slate palette are distinct from the shipped blue player and the assigned swept-blade interceptor design brief. The other worker asset was not read or modified.

Airframe is continuous, with fitted shoulder skins, three broad heat slots per side, recessed cheek ducts/grilles, dorsal exchangers, annular weapon mouth and seated exhaust machinery. No obvious detached or floating parts in inspected rest views.

Front red sensor cue and aft amber thrust face are visibly different. Offline AgX emission appears lighter/pinker than runtime toneMapped:false neon; exact authored and binding colors are recorded in the material map.
Steep negative bank exposes a dark underside; fitted belly hatch and paired heat rails add readable structure. Some underside detail remains dark under the neutral studio rig.

Sampled weave, strafe, ordinary/displaced orbit, committed peel, launch initial/transition and near-clamped launch bank retain a coherent silhouette. Exact +/-1.1 views are explicitly synthetic endpoint stress poses, not claimed sampled carrier states.

Common neutral view uses the required game camera/key/fill coordinates converted into Blender. The world-scale comparison imports the shipped player at unit scale alongside a unit-scale drone; the player is larger in world dimensions.

At 960x540 reconstructed Classic, the drone is small: warm clipped silhouette and amber exhaust remain detectable while panel details collapse. Modern/Chase rear views read the broad profile and amber exhaust; the forward red sensor is largely occluded from those views. The 1:1 strip preserves actual source pixels with no zoom or normalization.
Flash screenshot demonstrates the white shell geometry only. Rest/action images hide it. Default GLB scene excludes the shell, which is provided as a separately bound scene-1 template.

Debug shot image shows the root-based world shot origin and the cyan path crossing the rendered craft before emerging aft. Binary-front-normal check confirms eye faces +Z and exhaust faces -Z, so runtime FrontSide neon replacements are compatible.
initial_self_corrections: Nozzle vane positions corrected after initial pulse BVH intersections
Fitted belly hatch/heat rails added after actual underside PNG inspection
Rest scale envelope and viewport/render-hidden flash semantics corrected before freeze
GLB flash moved into non-default scene 1 to avoid a white default draw
limitations: Opus review/polish remains deferred; zero formal reviews/fix passes. This initial freeze is not final user acceptance or deployment.

Existing shot spawn at world +1.5Z does not follow graphics rotation; muzzle FX/aim/lead remain at root. Mouth-to-shot mismatch reaches about .8125 units in sampled displaced orbit. Some ordinary poses put the spawn near the barrel lip. Source-led rays intersect static authored geometry in 12/15 deterministic probes; no gameplay self-collision or sphere-sweep result is claimed.

Gameplay camera PNGs are offline Blender reconstructions at static source rig values. Dusk lighting is approximated; AgX differs from game ACES exposure1.02. No full sky/PMREM, bloom/fog/HUD, shake, camera lag or live occlusion is included.
No live performance/population/obstacle validation. The supplied peak18 layout proxy is not a live maximum; moving wings, carrier and boss still need integration profiling.
Pulse clearance uses discrete triangle-overlap tests and an engine-vertex nearest-surface proxy, not an exact continuous minimum-distance proof. Rigid root motion does not alter internal clearance.

The independently parsed GLB and clean Blender reimport are verified. A production Three.js loader binding and runtime disposal check remain integration work; RUNTIME_BINDINGS.md records clone ownership and hidden flash scene handling.
Reference thumbnails are individually framed only for style. Only the explicitly labeled player comparison and gameplay reconstructions assert common world scale.
